scripts.test:phase2b:server:gate-off: sh -c 'test ! -f "$HOME/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json" || { echo "Refusing Phase 2B emulator test: local Google ADC exists." >&2; exit 1; }; phase2b_config_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/morgan-bank-phase2b-firebase.XXXXXX) || exit 1; trap "rm -rf $phase2b_config_dir" EXIT HUP INT TERM; mkdir -p "$phase2b_config_dir/configstore"; printf "%s\n" "{\"motd\":{\"fetched\":4102444800000}}" > "$phase2b_config_dir/configstore/firebase-tools.json"; env -u DEBUG -u MULTI_TEACHER_V2_ENABLED -u GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS -u google_application_credentials -u FIREBASE_TOKEN -u GCLOUD_PROJECT -u GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT -u FIREBASE_CONFIG -u FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST -u FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST -u FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$phase2b_config_dir" METADATA_SERVER_DETECTION=none CI=true FIREBASE_CLI_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=true firebase emulators:exec --project demo-morgan-bank-phase2b-server-off-test --only auth,functions,firestore "env -u MULTI_TEACHER_V2_ENABLED PHASE2B_EMULATOR_TEST_MODE=gate-off node --test tests/phase2b/functions-auth.emulator.test.js"'
scripts.test:phase2b:server:gate-on: sh -c 'test ! -f "$HOME/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json" || { echo "Refusing Phase 2B emulator test: local Google ADC exists." >&2; exit 1; }; phase2b_config_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/morgan-bank-phase2b-firebase.XXXXXX) || exit 1; trap "rm -rf $phase2b_config_dir" EXIT HUP INT TERM; mkdir -p "$phase2b_config_dir/configstore"; printf "%s\n" "{\"motd\":{\"fetched\":4102444800000}}" > "$phase2b_config_dir/configstore/firebase-tools.json"; env -u DEBUG -u MULTI_TEACHER_V2_ENABLED -u GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS -u google_application_credentials -u FIREBASE_TOKEN -u GCLOUD_PROJECT -u GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT -u FIREBASE_CONFIG -u FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST -u FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST -u FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$phase2b_config_dir" METADATA_SERVER_DETECTION=none CI=true FIREBASE_CLI_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=true firebase emulators:exec --project demo-morgan-bank-phase2b-server-test --only auth,functions,firestore "env -u MULTI_TEACHER_V2_ENABLED PHASE2B_EMULATOR_TEST_MODE=gate-on node --test tests/phase2b/functions-auth.emulator.test.js"'
scripts.test:phase2b:server: npm run test:phase2b:server:gate-off && npm run test:phase2b:server:gate-on
scripts.test:all: npm run test:functions && npm run test:rules
